about.meta.title: About us: robotics integrator | Professional Robotics
about.meta.description: Independent robotics integrator: engineering and service. We don’t sell robots: we deploy solutions with measurable ROI and service them under an SLA.
about.hero.title: About us Professional Robotics
about.hero.lead: Professional Robotics is an independent robotics integrator: engineering and service.
about.hero.text: We sit between equipment manufacturers and business: the manufacturer builds the robot, the client wants to solve a task, and we turn one into the other. We select, deploy and service.
about.hero.chain.label: Diagram: the manufacturer builds the robot, Professional Robotics selects, deploys and services it, the business solves its task
about.hero.chain.title: Where we fit
about.numbers.label: Company in numbers
about.interest.title: Each side has its own interest.
about.interest.lead: We are deliberately neither a manufacturer nor a “robot shop.”
about.interest.maker.title: Manufacturer
about.interest.maker.text: Wants to sell its own hardware.
about.interest.shop.title: Robot shop
about.interest.us.title: We want the solution to pay back.
about.interest.us.text: Otherwise clients won’t come back to us for the next site and a service contract.
about.cycle.title: The whole project life cycle.
about.cycle.lead: From the first calculation to service throughout operation. Service is our particular strength: our own network across Russia and work under an SLA.
about.cycle.run.title: Service
about.cycle.run.text: Our own network across Russia, SLA-backed.
about.principles.title: Five principles we work by.
about.principles.result.title: We sell results, not robots
about.principles.result.text: The conversation starts with your economics, not with equipment specifications.
about.principles.independence.title: Independence from manufacturers
about.principles.independence.text: We take equipment from those who truly fit and are serviced. Several vendors for each area, not tied to one.
about.principles.engineering.title: Engineering over sales
about.principles.engineering.text: If robotics won’t pay back for you, we will say so plainly. A bad project hurts you and our reputation.
about.principles.service.title: Service is part of the solution
about.principles.service.text: A robot without maintenance stops. We are responsible for keeping it working, not only for delivery.
about.principles.measurable.title: Every project has a measurable result
about.principles.measurable.text: If the effect can’t be calculated, we don’t start the project.
about.own.title: Our own, not resold.
about.own.lead: The platform and AI agents are our development, the service network is ours. So we answer for how the solution works, not only for delivery.
about.own.platform.title: Our own platform
about.own.platform.text: Russian in-house software, not a resold vendor product. It brings robots from different manufacturers into one window.
about.own.agents.title: AI agents built in-house
about.own.agents.text: Predictive maintenance and real-time cleaning optimization.
about.own.network.title: Service network across Russia
about.own.network.text: A robot without service stops. We work under an SLA and set the response time in the contract.
about.now.title: The market is only starting. This is the window.
about.now.text1: Robotics in Russia is still at an early stage. Robot density is several times lower than in developed countries, service infrastructure is weak, and there are almost no strong integrators.
about.now.text2: For business this is a window: what becomes the norm in a few years gives a clear advantage now to those who deploy earlier.
about.now.window.label: Diagram: now the market is at the start and deploying gives an advantage; in a few years it will be the norm
about.now.window.nowNote: Early market, edge for those who deploy
